Package org.osgi.test.cases.event.tb1

Class Activator

java.lang.Object
org.osgi.test.cases.event.tb1.Activator
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.osgi.framework.BundleActivator, EventHandler, TBCService
public class Activator extends Object implements org.osgi.framework.BundleActivator, TBCService, EventHandler
A bundle that registers a service with the marker interface TBCService so it can be checked the exporter is correct.
